about: A cell-tower photo with its microwave dishes boxed by people, for the example finder's tests. Photo DJI_0395 from the Roboflow 'Cell Tower Detection v1' export (MIT licence, universe.roboflow.com/roger-ntabukiraniro-s-workspace/cell-tower-detection-ntv32), test split, resized to 1333 x 750 px as measured (celltower_1333) and saved again as JPEG quality 82. 'dish_boxes' are the people's boxes (COCO, category 'mw') converted to left, top, right, bottom and rounded to 0.1 px; 'marks' are three of them, given to the finder as the user's marks.
